sentences.en: ANDREW: Now we go to Jane who is going to tell us about what's happening in town this weekend.
sentences.zh: ANDREW: 现在我们请简来为大家介绍本周末镇上将要发生的活动。

sentences.en: JANE: Right, thanks Andrew, and now on to what's new, and do we really need yet another sports shop in Bradcaster?
sentences.zh: JANE: 好的，谢谢安德鲁。接下来介绍最新动态：布拉德卡斯特真的还需要再开一家体育用品店吗？

sentences.en: Well, most of you probably know Sports World - the branch of a Danish sports goods company that opened a few years ago it's attracted a lot of custom, and so the company has now decided to open another branch in the area.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们大多数人可能都知道‘体育世界’——这是一家丹麦体育用品公司的分店，几年前开业后吸引了大量顾客，因此该公司现已决定在本地区再开设一家分店。

sentences.en: It's going to be in the shopping centre to the west of Bradcaster, so that will be good news for all of you who've found the original shop in the north of the town hard to get to.
sentences.zh: 新店将设在布拉德卡斯特西部的购物中心内，这对那些觉得原店位于镇北部、交通不便的各位来说无疑是个好消息。

sentences.en: was invited to special preview and can promise you, this is the ultimate in sports retailing.
sentences.zh: 我受邀参加了特别预览活动，可以向大家保证，这里代表了体育零售业的最高水准。

sentences.en: The whole place has been given a new minimalist look with the company's signature colours of black and red.
sentences.zh: 整个店铺采用了全新的极简主义风格设计，并以公司标志性的黑红配色为主调。

sentences.en: The first three floors have a huge range of sports clothing as well as equipment, and on the top floor there's a café and a book and DVD a section.
sentences.zh: 一至三楼陈列着种类繁多的运动服饰及器材，而顶层则设有一家咖啡馆以及图书与DVD专区。

sentences.en: You'll find all the well-known names as well as some less well- known ones.
sentences.zh: 您将在这里找到所有知名品牌，同时也有一些知名度稍低的品牌。

sentences.en: If they haven't got exactly what you want in stock they promise to get it for you in ten days.
sentences.zh: 如果店内没有您想要的商品现货，他们承诺将在十天内为您调货到位。

sentences.en: Unlike the other store, where it www.TopSage.com can take up to fourteen days.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，另一家门店的调货时间则可能长达十四天。

sentences.en: They cover all the major sports, including football, tennis and swimming, but they particularly focus on running, and they claim to have the widest range of equipment in the country.
sentences.zh: 他们涵盖所有主要运动项目，包括足球、网球和游泳，但尤其专注于跑步，并声称拥有全国最齐全的跑步装备。

sentences.en: As well as that, a whole section of the third floor is devoted to sports bags, including the latest designs from the States - if you can't find what you want here, it doesn't exist!
sentences.zh: 此外，三楼的整个区域都专门用于体育包，包括来自美国的最新设计——如果你在这里找不到你想要的，那它就根本不存在！

sentences.en: The shop will be open from 9.00 am this Saturday and if you go along to the opening then you'll have the chance to meet the national 400 metres running champion Paul King, who's coming along to open the shop, and he will be staying around until about midday to chat to any fans who want to meet him and sign autographs.
sentences.zh: 这家商店将于本周六上午9点开业，如果你参加开业活动，就有机会见到英国400米跑全国冠军保罗·金（Paul King），他将亲临现场为商店剪彩；他将在店内停留至中午左右，与任何想见他的粉丝交谈并签名。

sentences.en: Then there will be a whole range of special attractions all weekend.
sentences.zh: 随后整个周末都将推出一系列特别活动。

sentences.en: There will be free tickets for local sporting events for the first 50 customers, and also a special competition open to all.
sentences.zh: 前50名顾客将获赠本地体育赛事的免费门票，此外还将举办一项面向所有人的特别竞赛。

sentences.en: Just answer fifteen out of twenty sports questions correctly to win a signed copy of Paul King's DVD 'Spring Tips', while the first person to get all the questions correct gets a year's free membership of the Bradcaster Gym.
sentences.zh: 只要在20道体育知识题中答对15道，即可赢得保罗·金签名版DVD《春季训练贴士》（Spring Tips）；首位全部答对者还可获得布拉德卡斯特健身中心（Bradcaster Gym）为期一年的免费会员资格。

sentences.en: All entrants will receive a special Sports calendar with details of all Bradcaster fixtures in the coming year.
sentences.zh: 所有参赛者都将获赠一份特别版体育日历，其中详列了布拉德卡斯特（Bradcaster）来年全部赛事安排。

sentences.en: One of the special opening offers is a fitness test - a complete review of your cardiac fitness and muscle tone, actually done in the shop by qualified staff.
sentences.zh: 本次开业特惠之一是体能测试——由持证工作人员在店内为你提供全面的心脏健康状况与肌肉张力评估。

sentences.en: This would normally cost £30.00 but is available at half & 20 price for this month only.
sentences.zh: 此项服务通常收费30英镑，但本月仅需半价即15英镑。

sentences.en: There are only a limited number of places available for this, so to make a booking phone 560341.
sentences.zh: 该测试名额有限，如需预约，请拨打560341。

sentences.en: In addition, if you open an account you get lots more special offers including the chance to try out equipment at special open evenings
sentences.zh: 此外，凡开设账户者还可享受更多特别优惠，包括在特定开放晚间试用器材的机会。
